arStrings.szText: "Please tell me you're not an outlaw in Skovos."
Not this time, no. Believe it or not, I’m rather close to the Amazon Queen of Skovos. Her name is Adreona.
Lorath responds with a smirk--a reaction to the Player's question.
How close?
Intrigued. You never knew Lorath had a fling with a queen.
As close as a Horadrim can get to anyone. We haven’t seen each other in years, but she’ll remember me. Just hope she remembers…the good things.
Confident at first, then remembering his relationship with Adreona might have been a little tricky at the end.
We’ll need her help to track down this weapon made by Lilith. But time is short.
Getting to business, focusing on the task ahead.
Mephisto is days ahead of us. He’ll have a foothold on the isles.
Getting to business, focusing on the task ahead.
And if all else fails, I’ve brought something for that too: the Sightless Eye. It once belonged to the Oracle of Skovos, and Neyrelle thought she might be able to help us. Not sure why or how, but—
Full sentence at the end would be "Not sure why or how, but we'll figure out a way." But Lorath gets cut off when the Hand of Akarat speaks from a higher deck.
There you are. The old man with not a dark impulse in his heart, and the stranger with something unspeakable in theirs.
Projected 20 ft.
This fool again. Mind giving us some privacy?
First part is muttered to self in annoyance. Second sentence is projected over 20 feet to the Acolyte.
Nothing is hidden from His eyes and ears. Even this vast sea is so small compared to Him.
This is the preacher from the docks of Backwater. He has more of a gentle but firm tone--not screaming or fanatical. But his gentleness is eerie.
And we are even smaller. Just little people in little boats, swept up in the tide...
Projected 20 ft.
And my master—he is the tide!
Projected 20 ft. Raising his voice as he prepares to summon monsters from the deeps.
